senses.gloss: (cmp. preced; a. קְשֵׁי) [to be hard, cmp. יָשַׁן,] to be old.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 12:2">Targ. I Sam. XII, 2</cite> <he>קַשֵּׁית</he> Levita (Regia <cite ref="S02270"><he>קָשֵׁית</he></cite>; ed. Wil. <cite ref="S02251"><he>קָשֵׁישׁ</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="S02251"><he>קַשִּׁישׁ</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 95b:1">Keth. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>וקַשׁ לחמש שנין</he> and after five years the orchard grew old (ceased to bear).
<cite ref="Ketubot 95b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>כיון … עביד דקִישׁ</he> since they knew that an orchard is liable to get old.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 167b:15">B. Bath. 167ᵇ</cite> <he>מֵיקַשׁ הוא דקַשְׁיָא וכ׳</he> Ms. R. (ed. <he>מיקש הוא דקַשָּׁה לה</he>; Rashb. <he>מִיקְשָׁא קשיא</he>) she has grown old, and her voice is rough.
<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:7">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>לא קַשָּׁאִי</he> I am not old enough; <he>כי קַשׁ נח וכ׳</he> when he was old enough, R. Joḥ. was dead. Ib. 5ᵇ.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>יהא רעוא דתֵיקוּשׁ ותינוק ולא תמות</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="H00954"><he>חל</he></cite> 3 (ed. <he>יהא רעוא דלא תמות</he>) be it God’s will that thou grow old and grow young again and never die; a. e.—V. <cite ref="S02251"><he>קַשִּׁישׁ</he></cite>.
